title: EvMessage
description: EV wire protocol between the Tauri app (Rust) and ev-core (Python). One JSON object per WebSocket text frame. Changes are additive; removing or renaming a field requires a protocol version bump.

ProtocolVersion.description: Protocol version of the sender. Receivers compare it with their own and reply with an error of code protocol_mismatch when they differ.

Version.description: Semantic version string of a component.

detail.description: User-facing explanation when state is disabled or failed.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. New codes may be added; receivers treat unknown codes as internal.

detail.description: Technical detail for logs. Never shown in the island.

HelloMessage.description: Rust -> core. First message after the WebSocket opens.

PingMessage.description: Rust -> core. Liveness check, sent every 5 s.

PongMessage.description: core -> Rust. Answer to ping; reply_to carries the ping id.

ErrorMessage.description: Either direction. reply_to carries the id of the message that caused it, when known.

ShutdownMessage.description: Rust -> core. Core stops modules, closes the socket and exits with code 0.

TurnId.description: The id of the chat.send message that started the turn.

text.description: User input. Core refuses text over its own limit with chat.failed.

effort.description: Requested effort; omitted means the configured default.

spoken.description: The user said it (F-008); core speaks the reply. Omitted means typed.

model.description: Absent when the rule router answers without a model.

first_token_ms.description: Request received to first reply token.

cancelled.description: True when a cancel or a newer message ended the turn early.

ChatSendMessage.description: Rust -> core. Start a turn; the message id becomes the turn id. A newer chat.send cancels a running turn.

ChatCancelMessage.description: Rust -> core. Stop a running turn; core still sends chat.done with cancelled = true.

ChatResetMessage.description: Rust -> core. Start a new chat: cancel any running turn and clear the conversation history (F-414).

ChatToolMessage.description: core -> Rust. A tool step changed state.

ChatDoneMessage.description: core -> Rust. A turn ended normally or was cancelled.

ChatFailedMessage.description: core -> Rust. A turn ended with an error.

LlmStatusMessage.description: core -> Rust. Model load state changed.

unit.description: Unit shown after integer values, such as px, ms, min or tokens.

widget.description: Control the Settings window draws instead of the plain one for its kind (F-415). menu: a drop-down for long choice lists. Absent: the plain control.

role.description: For widget = model: which model role the setting chooses (small, default or large).

steps.description: For widget = slider: the values the slider stops at, ascending. Absent: every integer from minimum to maximum.

labels.description: For kind = choice: display names, in the same order as options. Absent: show the options as they are.

ConfigGetMessage.description: Rust -> core. Ask for the current settings; core answers config.state.

ConfigSetMessage.description: Rust -> core. Change one setting; core answers config.state or config.rejected.

ConfigResetMessage.description: Rust -> core. Return one setting to its default; core answers config.state.

ConfigStateMessage.description: core -> Rust. Every setting with its value; also sent when config.toml changes on disk.

ConfigRejectedMessage.description: core -> Rust. A change was refused; config.toml is unchanged.

ModelEntry.description: One catalog model and its state on this PC (docs/FEATURES.md F-403).

error.description: User-facing reason when state is failed.

models_dir.description: Absolute path of the models folder.

other_files.description: Model files (.gguf) in the models folder that are not in the catalog, by file name (F-415).

ModelsGetMessage.description: Rust -> core. Ask for the model list; core answers models.state.

ModelsDownloadMessage.description: Rust -> core. Download a catalog model (resumes a partial download). Core answers models.state.

ModelsCancelMessage.description: Rust -> core. Stop a download; the partial file is kept for a later resume.

ModelsStateMessage.description: core -> Rust. Every catalog model with its state; also sent on download progress (at most 4/s).

question.description: Exactly what will happen, e.g. "Close Notepad?".

ToolConfirmMessage.description: core -> Rust. A confirm/dangerous step waits for the user's yes or no (F-418).

ToolAnswerMessage.description: Rust -> core. The user's answer to tool.confirm.

ToolConfirmClosedMessage.description: core -> Rust. The question is gone: answered, timed out (no) or its request was cancelled.

ActionRecordedMessage.description: core -> Rust. An action that changed something was logged (F-111).

ActionUndoMessage.description: Rust -> core. Undo one action, or the latest when action_id is absent.

missed.description: It came due while EV was off.

TimerFiredMessage.description: core -> Rust. A timer, reminder or alarm came due (F-108).

FocusChangedMessage.description: core -> Rust. Focus mode turned on or off (F-109).

ContextCaptureMessage.description: Rust -> core. The hotkey opened EV: read the text selected in the app the user was in (F-201).

ContextCapturedMessage.description: core -> Rust. Result of context.capture; text is absent when nothing was selected.

ContextClearMessage.description: Rust -> core. The user removed the selection chip.

ContextReplaceMessage.description: Rust -> core. Replace the captured selection with this text (F-202).

VoicePackEntry.description: One voice pack and its state on this PC (F-010).

option.description: The setting value that uses this pack (voice.recognizer size, or kokoro).

error.description: User-facing reason when state is failed.

reason.description: typing: mic off and speech stops. closed: panel closed, mic off, speech goes on. button: mic off. send: push-to-talk released, send what was heard. silence: stop speaking and close the mic.

message.description: Why voice stopped or could not start, in plain words.

level.description: Mic level 0..1, about 15 times a second while the mic is open.

final.description: The user stopped talking: the app sends text as a spoken chat message.

VoiceStartMessage.description: Rust -> core. Open the mic and listen (F-008).

VoiceStopMessage.description: Rust -> core. Stop listening and/or speaking (F-008).

VoiceStateMessage.description: core -> Rust. Mic and speech state, with a message when voice stopped or failed.

VoiceLevelMessage.description: core -> Rust. Live mic level for the island.

VoiceHeardMessage.description: core -> Rust. Words recognized so far; final when the user stopped talking.
